idea-plugin.name: Tempest Remote
idea-plugin.description:
Open saved Tempest SSH servers directly from JetBrains Gateway.

Select a saved server in Tempest, then choose its SSH configuration in Gateway's native wizard. Tempest CLI manages accounts, SSH credentials, proxies, jump hosts and connection lifetime.

Gateway handles project and IDE selection, installation, startup, progress and the JetBrains Client.

Requires Tempest CLI with direct SSH endpoint support (remote.ensure.ssh), Node.js 18+ and JetBrains Gateway locally. The selected vault must permit TCP forwarding. Remote hosts must meet JetBrains' requirements.

Documentation · Source code and issue tracker
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Thin bootstrap from saved Tempest servers into Gateway's native SSH wizard.
  • Native Gateway SSH to the CLI’s existing loopback endpoint with strict host-key verification.
  • Embedded server picker, local authentication, native progress and cancellation.
